title: Pronouns
desc: Words used to refer to people (e.g. I, you, we) as the subject of a sentence.

title: Objective-Pronouns
desc: Pronouns used as the object of a verb or preposition (e.g. me, him, us). In Arabic, they are attached as suffixes.

title: Prepositions
desc: Words that show relationships between nouns/pronouns and other words (e.g. in, on, with). They are used as prefixes or separate words.

title: Interrogative-Words
desc: Words used to ask questions (e.g. who, what, where).

title: Basic-Conversation
desc: Basic conversation questions and answers using pronouns, prepositions and interrogative words.

title: Demonstratives
desc: Words used to point out or indicate something (e.g. this, that, these, those).

title: Negation-and-Affirmation
desc: Words used to express negation (e.g. no, not) and affirmation (e.g. yes).

title: Everyday-Nouns
desc: Common nouns used in everyday life (e.g. book, table, chair).
